title: Downloads fixes and dashboard refinements
summary: More accurate SABnzbd activity, clearer phone layouts, and repairs for replaced movies and Jellyfin links.
highlights: SABnzbd activity now follows progress between updates. SABnzbd and NZBGet cards no longer repeat the whole client's speed for each job.
History has expandable playback details on phones. Statistics, typography and mobile navigation have also been refined.
Now Playing keeps media details and avatars current while diagnostics are open. Downloads preserves keyboard focus during refresh, and Server Activity identifies cached timestamps.
Manually link a deleted movie to its replacement to combine Statistics and restore artwork while keeping the original History records.
Use the optional JELLYFIN_LINK_URL setting when your browser needs a different Jellyfin address from the one Jellydash uses for API requests.
